evidence.captured_touch_drag: Implicit touch capture delivers pointerup to the pressed button with the finger's real clientX/clientY. use-composer-input.ts:77-86 compares that point with currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect(). If the point is outside, it clears recordPointerDown and sets cancelledPointerClick. CoachMic.tsx:152-154 then clears activationMode, and Composer.tsx:43 wires the same handler onto the secondary Send. The later buttons=0 pointerleave is still ignored, but the guard no longer depends on it. The textarea blur that follows sees recordPointerDown=false and exits editing. Both residual findings are closed: prior #1 (recordPointerDown stuck) and prior new-bug #2 (activationMode stuck after touch drag-off). The test at tap-control.test.tsx:179-207 now fires a realistic captured sequence: down inside, move outside, up outside, then leave with buttons=0 and no active leave.
evidence.trailing_click_suppression: onActionClick (use-composer-input.ts:71-76) consumes the cancel flag once and suppresses only when detail>0. A trailing pointer click after an outside release or a pointercancel is dropped. The flag is always reset afterwards, so it never applies twice.
evidence.stale_stop_restart: The Stop branch (CoachMic.tsx:182-185) now reads live hold.view().listening and calls hold.release() rather than toggleTap(). A Stop click landing after auto-end but before the React commit sees listening=false and does nothing. It does not press() and does not set manualStop, which removes the chained manual-mis-tag path. release() with no id matches the KEYBOARD_POINTER that press() stored (hold.ts:62,87). The Record branch uses press(), which is a no-op while the controller is already busy (hold.ts:59), and it is also gated on locked and reviewPending. The test at :263-280 dispatches the click inside act, before the commit, and asserts that no second handler starts and that Review still appears.
evidence.review_ref_ordering: publish writes reviewPending synchronously (CoachMic.tsx:106) before setState. The Send, Review and Record branches read the ref, not the lagging prop. A stale 'send' or 'record' closure therefore cannot bypass Review, and a stale 'review' closure cannot acknowledge anything once the ref is already false.
evidence.fresh_activation_recovery: Every fresh pointerdown resets the cancel flag: main via onActionStart (:148) and secondary via onRecordPointerDown (use-composer-input.ts:62-65). Enter or Space keydown resets it on both buttons (CoachMic.tsx:163, Composer.tsx:46-48). A detail=0 assistive-technology or keyboard click is never suppressed by a stale flag. Tests at :209-238 cover a fresh pointer Send and an assistive-technology Send after an outside release with no trailing click.
evidence.mode_vs_live_predicate: Stop mode is derived from view.listening, and the click gate uses the same live predicate, so the gate cannot block a Stop that the UI legitimately offers.

limits: Review only. I executed nothing. The reported 20/20 DOM, tsc, lint, the 328 focused tests and the full-suite results are not verified by me.

No device proof. The following are assumed from the Pointer Events spec, not observed: iOS Safari's click-after-pointerup ordering and coordinates while the software keyboard is up, Android pointercancel on pan, and whether a real browser emits a click at all after a captured outside release.

Behavioral note, not a defect: mouse or pen press, leave with buttons held, then re-enter and release inside now cancels the click, because the flag was set on leave and pointerup inside does not clear it. A native button would click. This matches 'leave cancels' semantics.
Hit geometry is the bounding box. On the round 44px button, corner releases count as inside. This is harmless.
jsdom returns zero rects when coordinates are unmocked (:36, :248-253, :306-308). Those tests pass because 0,0 counts as inside a zero box, not because the geometry is exercised.
The act()-wrapped stale-click test models the commit lag but not real scheduler timing against a native SpeechRecognition 'end' task.
Out of scope and not assessed: TTS, Kimi, land, full-history approval.
